name: application-rich-tooltip-chart
title: Rich Tooltip Chart
description: A line chart paired with a floating tooltip card that shows per-series color swatches, exact values, and a delta badge for the highlighted datapoint.
useWhen: A chart datapoint needs to communicate more than one series' value at once, with color-coded context.
Pairing a hover or focus interaction on a chart with a comparison to a prior period (a delta badge).
avoidWhen: The chart has a single series — a plain axis label or a minimal single-value tooltip is less visual noise.
You need the full chart primitive itself, not just the tooltip treatment — start from the existing `charts` component and layer this tooltip pattern on top.
responsiveBehavior: The tooltip is a fixed-width card anchored by percentage position along the chart's width; reserve enough top margin above the chart for the card to render without clipping at any viewport width.
accessibility: Each series in the tooltip pairs a color swatch with a text label so the mapping isn't color-only.
The delta indicator combines an arrow icon with signed percentage text, not color alone, to convey direction.
In a real implementation, the tooltip's content should also be exposed to screen readers via an accessible description tied to the focused/hovered point, not only shown visually on hover.

variants.title: Multi-series tooltip
variants.description: A two-series line chart with a floating tooltip card anchored above the highlighted date, showing both series' values and a week-over-week delta.
accessibility: Series color swatches are paired with text labels ('Desktop', 'Mobile') both in the tooltip and the chart legend.

variants.title: Multi-series tooltip (Dark)
variants.description: Multi-series tooltip chart adapted for dark surfaces, with series colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Line colors, gridlines, and tooltip text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
